## `gmail_batch_delete`

Class: delete

Permanently delete multiple Gmail messages. Irreversible.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `messageIds` | array | required | Message IDs (up to 1000) |

## `gmail_batch_modify`

Class: update

Add/remove labels across up to 1000 Gmail messages at once. Useful for bulk archiving, marking as read, etc.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `messageIds` | array | required | Message IDs (up to 1000) |
| `addLabelIds` | array | optional | Label IDs to add |
| `removeLabelIds` | array | optional | Label IDs to remove |

## `gmail_create_draft`

Class: create

Create a Gmail draft without sending

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `to` | string | optional | Recipient(s), comma-separated. Optional when replyToMessageId is set (derived from the source); a supplied value wins. |
| `subject` | string | optional | Email subject. Optional when replyToMessageId is set (derived as "Re: ..."); a supplied value wins. |
| `body` | string | required | Email body as Markdown (headings, links, lists, tables, blockquotes). Rendered to HTML for the rich part; the Markdown source is the plain-text part. |
| `htmlBody` | string | optional | REMOVED in v6: author Markdown in `body` instead; for literal HTML (e.g. inline color) pass `allowRawHtml: true`. Passing htmlBody now errors. |
| `allowRawHtml` | boolean | optional | When true, raw HTML in `body` passes through into the HTML part instead of being escaped. Default false (HTML is shown literally). |
| `cc` | string | optional | CC recipients, comma-separated. With replyToMessageId + replyAll, derived from the source minus your own addresses; a supplied value wins. |
| `replyToMessageId` | string | optional | Message ID to reply to. Sets In-Reply-To/References and, unless overridden, derives to/subject (and cc when replyAll) from the source, so you need not read it first. |
| `replyAll` | boolean | optional | With replyToMessageId: include the source To+Cc (minus your own addresses) in cc. Default false (reply to sender only). |
| `replyToThreadId` | string | optional | Thread ID to associate the draft with |
| `attachments` | array | optional | Files to attach (each { path, filename?, contentType? }); path must be absolute |

## `gmail_download_attachment`

Class: read

Download an email attachment to local disk. Use gmail_read first to get the attachmentId.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `messageId` | string | required | The Gmail message ID |
| `attachmentId` | string | required | The attachment ID from gmail_read response |
| `filename` | string | required | Filename to save as (e.g. report.xlsx) |
| `savePath` | string | required | Destination folder to save into, on the machine running the server: confined to GOOGLE_LOCAL_FILES_DIR (default <home>/Downloads/mcp-google-multi), created if missing; a relative path resolves inside it, an absolute path must already be inside it. The file name comes from `filename`. |

## `gmail_read`

Class: read

Read a full Gmail message by ID (body capped at 50k chars unless full=true). Pass `headers` for metadata mode: no body decoding, just id, threadId, labelIds and the named headers.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `messageId` | string | required | Gmail message ID |
| `full` | boolean | optional | Return the entire body without the character cap |
| `rawHtml` | boolean | optional | Return the HTML body unconverted instead of the plain-text rendering (HTML-only messages) |
| `headers` | array | optional | Header names to fetch in metadata mode instead of the full body (e.g. ["Subject", "From"]) |

## `gmail_read_batch`

Class: read

Read many Gmail messages by ID in one call, collapsing the search→read triage loop. Bodies are capped at 50k chars each (unless full=true) and the aggregate output is bounded. Returns one ordered entry per id plus a trailing counts summary; a single failed id does NOT fail the batch. Pass `headers` for metadata mode: no body decoding, just id, threadId, labelIds and the named headers per entry.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `ids` | array | required | Gmail message IDs to read (1..100). Comma-separated string or JSON array. |
| `full` | boolean | optional | Return entire bodies without the per-message 50k character cap |
| `rawHtml` | boolean | optional | Return HTML bodies unconverted instead of the plain-text rendering (HTML-only messages) |
| `headers` | array | optional | Header names to fetch in metadata mode instead of full bodies (e.g. ["Subject", "From"]) |

## `gmail_read_thread`

Class: read

Read all messages in a Gmail thread (bodies capped at 50k chars each unless full=true). mode=summary returns headers + snippets only.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `threadId` | string | required | Gmail thread ID |
| `full` | boolean | optional | Return entire bodies without the character cap |
| `rawHtml` | boolean | optional | Return HTML bodies unconverted instead of the plain-text rendering (HTML-only messages) |
| `mode` | enum | optional | full = complete bodies; summary = per-message headers and snippet only |

## `gmail_search`

Class: read

Search messages in a Gmail account. Returns compact rows (id, from, subject, date, snippet); pass full=true for threadId, to, labelIds and the untruncated snippet. For a recurring "what is new" sweep, prefer gmail_list_history over polling this with since.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `query` | string | required | Gmail search syntax, e.g. "from:alice is:unread" |
| `maxResults` | number | optional | Max results to return (default: 20, max: 100) |
| `full` | boolean | optional | Return the full row shape instead of the compact default |
| `since` | string | optional | Only messages on/after this ISO 8601 date (00:00 UTC) or date-time with Z or offset, added to the query as after:<epoch seconds> |
| `until` | string | optional | Only messages before this ISO 8601 date (00:00 UTC) or date-time with Z or offset, added to the query as before:<epoch seconds> |
| `includeSpamTrash` | boolean | optional | Include Spam and Trash in the search. Gmail excludes both by default, even for in:anywhere. |
